title: Effect of Intranasal Anti-IgE Antibodies on IgE Production
brief_summary: In this study, participants will receive either intranasal anti-IgE-antibodies (n=5) or intranasal allergen (n=5) or intranasal placebo (n=5). Blood samples will be obtained before nasal administration of study drugs and 3, 5 and 8 weeks thereafter. In the serum samples, specific and total IgE levels will be assessed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

birch pollen allergy

Exclusion Criteria:

history of anaphylaxis autoimmune diseases treatment with corticosteroids, antihistamines, immunosuppressant drugs, beta-blockers significant medical conditions pregnancy or lactation
